dish.note: Apple rings in light batter, fried hot and rolled in cinnamon sugar.
dish.how: Peel and core 4 apples, slice into 1cm rings. Whisk 200g self-raising flour, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 egg and 250ml milk to a smooth batter. Dip the rings and fry in 180C oil for 2 minutes a side in batches until golden, drain on paper and roll in 4 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve hot with cream.

steps.text: Peel, core and slice the apples into rings.
Whisk the flour, sugar, egg and milk to a smooth batter.
Dip the rings and fry in 180C oil, 2 minutes a side, in batches.
Drain, roll in the cinnamon sugar and serve hot with cream.

dish.make_ahead: Make the batter up to 2 hours ahead; fry just before serving
